verdict.rationale: Weave provides a documented Service API (REST) for programmatic access to traces/evals, plus an official MCP server (wandb-mcp-server) explicitly described as letting coding agents like Claude Code 'read live production data, run evaluations, and execute automatic iteration loops on their own.' This directly matches the story of an agent querying traces/metrics/evals to debug an app. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the MCP server in real debugging workflows beyond vendor docs.
